description: Read a document's chunks in order starting at a chunk index — paginate through a document, or read what came AFTER a chunk you found via search (set start_index to that chunk's index + 1). Feed next_index back in to page forward.

inputs.name: document_id
inputs.description: The document to read chunks from

inputs.name: knowledge_base
inputs.description: The knowledge base, from a Knowledge Base node. If omitted, falls back to the flow's default knowledge base.

inputs.name: start_index
inputs.description: First chunk index to read (0-based). To continue after a found chunk, use its index + 1.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Maximum number of chunks to return

outputs.name: next_index
outputs.description: start_index for the next page, or null if there are no more chunks

outputs.name: has_more
outputs.description: Whether more chunks remain after this page
